_README: Curated, client-facing reason/disposition overrides for the Encore deliverable workbook. COMMITTED (durable) home for blocked/skipped/manual reasons that have no other committed source — replaces the gitignored, GC-prone fixme-registry.json baseline-restoration entries (LR-ENC-004, 2026-06-05). Applied by export_test_cases/to-xlsx.ts AFTER augment+overlay, BEFORE the Pass+reason integrity throw. Per entry: 'coverage' (optional, e.g. 'Manual'), 'execution' (''|'Skipped'|'Blocked'), 'reason' (client-safe professional text — NO slang, framework, BUG-IDs, or contradictions; passes scripts/xlsx-lint-rules.mjs). Do NOT add a reason to a Passing test (would trip C1).

TC-LOS-BAS-048.reason: Skipped — toggling Room Active does not mark the form as changed, so Save stays disabled and the change cannot be saved. Pending an application fix.

TC-LOC-AAO-016.reason: Requires a second location whose add-on configuration differs from the standard test office; cannot be exercised from the standard test office.

_README_DROPPED_NOT_AUTOMATABLE: Disposition (LR-ENC-004 V3, 2026-06-05): ACC-021/024 were investigated and found not automatable because the underlying application behavior does not support the test. They stay in the catalog as 'Pending Automation' with an explanatory reason instead of a blank-body row; the internal DROPPED status remains in the MD source only. No fabrication — each reason is reworded from the documented MD Reason.

TC-LOC-ACC-024.reason: Not automated — switching tabs while there are unsaved changes does not trigger an Unsaved Changes prompt on this page, so there is no dialog behavior to verify.
